This section documents the individual harvesters used by **SVP Harvester** to retrieve bibliographic references from
external sources.

> 🔗 For how harvesting is triggered and orchestrated at the CRISalid system level — RabbitMQ messages,
> `harvesters.yaml`, the `HARVESTERS` environment variable — see [Harvesting Configuration](../map/harvesting.qmd).
> This section covers what each individual harvester does **once triggered**.

> 🔗 For how SVP Harvester keeps track of an entity's identifiers across successive requests, see
> [Entity Resolution & Identifier Alignment](entity-resolution.qmd).
>
> 🔗 For the common target data model that harvested references are converted into, see
> [Reference: Data Model](data-model.qmd).

---

## 🧱 Harvester architecture

Each harvester is a self-contained module made of two parts:

1. **Data Fetcher / Client** — retrieves data from a specific source (JSON API, SPARQL endpoint, SRU endpoint, ...).
2. **Converter** — transforms the fetched data into the shared reference format, aligned with the
   [SciencePlus data model](https://documentation.abes.fr/aidescienceplusabes/index.html#ModeleGeneral) (Dublin Core,
   Bibo, Vivo, ...).

Harvesters are registered through a **factory class** inheriting from `AbstractHarvesterFactory`. The list of active
harvesters is declared in `harvesters.yaml` (see
[Harvester — Available Harvesters](../map/harvesting.qmd#harvester--available-harvesters)).

All harvesters run on `asyncio`, so the harvesters triggered for a given entity execute **in parallel**.

---

## 🔀 Triggering logic

When an entity's identifiers are received, each harvester independently decides whether it is relevant, based on the
identifiers it supports (see the per-harvester pages below). A harvester will **not** run if:

- it is not declared in `harvesters.yaml`, or
- it is excluded by the `harvesters` parameter of the request, or
- none of the identifiers it supports are present for the entity

---

## 📚 Available harvesters

| Harvester | Source | Supported identifiers | Credentials required |
|---|---|---|---|
| [HAL](hal.qmd) | HAL API | idhali, idhals, orcid | — |
| [IdRef](idref.qmd) | IdRef SPARQL endpoint (+ sub-harvesters) | idref, orcid | — |
| [OpenAlex](openalex.qmd) | OpenAlex API | orcid | — |
| [ScanR](scanr.qmd) | ScanR API | idref, orcid, idhals | `SCANR_ES_USER`, `SCANR_ES_PASSWORD`, `SCANR_ES_HOST` |
| [Scopus](scopus.qmd) | Scopus API | Scopus EID | `SCOPUS_API_KEY`, `SCOPUS_INST_TOKEN` |
